senses.gloss: 1. प्र॑ति ind. (as a prefix to roots and their derivative nouns and other n˚, sometimes प्रती; for 2. See p. 664) towards, near to
against, in opposition to
back, again, in return
down upon, upon, on
before nouns it expresses also likeness or comparison (cf. प्रति-चन्द्र)
or it forms Avyayībhāvas of different kinds (cf. प्रति-क्षणम्, प्रति-ग्रहम्, प्रत्य्-अग्नि &c.; rarely ifc., e.g. सूपप्रति, a little broth, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 9)

or as a prep. with usually preceding acc., in the sense of towards, against, to, upon, in the direction of (e.g. शब्दम् प्˚, in the dir˚ of the sound, R.; अग्निम् प्र्˚, against the fire, Mn.; also ˚त्य्-अग्नि ind., Pāṇ. vi, 2, 33, Sch.; रिपुम् प्र्˚, ag˚ the enemy, Mn.; आत्मानम् प्र्˚, to one's self, Ratnāv.)
opposite, before, in the presence of (e.g. रोदसी प्र्˚, bef˚ heaven and earth, RV.)

in comparison, on a par with, in proportion to (e.g. इन्द्रम् प्र्˚, in compar˚ with I˚, RV.; सहस्राणि प्र्˚, on a par with i.e. equivalent to thousands, ib.; also with abl. or -तस्; cf. Pāṇ. i, 4, 92; ii, 3, 11)

in the vicinity of, near, beside, at, on (e.g. यूपम् प्र्˚, near the sacrificial post, AitBr.; गङ्गाम् प्र्˚, at or on the Ganges, R.; एतत् प्र्˚, at this point, TS.; आयोधनम् प्र्˚, on the field of battle, MBh.)
at the time of, about, through, for (e.g. फाल्गुनम् प्र्˚, about the month Ph˚, Mn.; चिरम् प्र्˚, for a long time, MBh.; भृशम् प्र्˚, often, repeatedly, Car.)

or used distributively (cf. Pāṇ. i, 4, 90) to express at every, in or on every, severally (e.g. यज्ञम् प्र्˚, at every sacrifice, Yājñ.; यज्ञं यज्ञम् प्र्˚, TS.; वर्षम् प्र्˚, every year, annually, Pañcat.; in this sense often comp.; cf. above)
in favour of, for (Pāṇ. i, 4, 90; e.g. पाण्डवान् प्र्˚, in favour of the P˚s, MBh.)
on account of, with regard to, concerning (Pāṇ.; ib., e.g. सीमाम् प्र्˚, conc˚ a boundary, Mn.; गौतमम् प्र्˚, with reg˚ to G˚, R.)

conformably or according to (e.g. माम् प्र्˚, acc˚ to me, i.e. in my opinion, Mālav.; cf. माम् प्रत्य् अरण्यवत् प्रतिभाति, ‘it seems to me like a forest’, Hit.; न बुभुक्षितम् प्रति भाति किं चित्, ‘to a hungry man nothing is of any account’, Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 3, 2)
as, for (after a verb meaning, ‘to regard or consider’; cf. Vikr. iv, 69)
or as prep. with abl. in return or as compensation for, instead or in the place of (Pāṇ. i, 4, 92, Sch.)
with abl. or -तस् See above
with abl. or gen. (?) to express, ‘about’, ‘at the time of’ (only प्रति वस्तोः, ‘at daybreak’, RV.)
as prep. with gen. = with reference to, Hariv. 10967.
प्रति [cf. Zd. paiti; Gk. προτί, ποτί, πρός.]
प्रति in comp. with nouns not immediately connected with roots.
2. प्रति m. N. of a son of Kuśa, BhP.
1. प्रती in comp. for प्रति (cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 122, Vārtt. 3, Pat.)
प्र॑-त्ति f. giving away, giving, gift, TS.; AitBr.
1. प्राति f. filling (= पूर्ति), L.
the span of the thumb and forefinger, L.

2. प्राति (for 1. See under √ प्रा), Vṛddhi or lengthened form of 1. प्रति in comp. In the following derivatives formed with 2. प्राति only the second member of the simple compound from which they come is given in the parentheses (leaving the preposition प्रति, which is lengthened to प्राति in the derivatives, to be supplied).
